theorems.name: Submission.c1approx_egorov_closed_compact_uniform
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (C : Set (Rn n)) (F : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ) (G : Rn n → ℝ), MeasurableSet C → (∀ k, Measurable (F k)) → Measurable G → (∀ x ∈ C, Tendsto (fun k ↦ F k x) atTop (𝓝 (G x))) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ A ⊆ C, IsClosed A ∧ volume (C \ A) < ENNReal.ofReal ε ∧ ∀ K ⊆ A, IsCompact K → TendstoUniformlyOn F G atTop K
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
